text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out with Nakayama
Festa...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh. That really takes me back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice Nakayama Festa eyeing a claw
machine
filled with Cuties.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I used to kill time while skipping school
playing
claw machines.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Really? You've got some guts. I should
warn you,
I'm pretty good at this.
choice_data_list: どっちが多く獲れるか、勝負しない？
choice_data_list_en: Wanna see who can catch more?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
First, let's see what you've got. Don't
disappoint
me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
